entry.title: CFTC Staff Clears Fast Track for Stock-Index Perpetual Conversions

entry.summary: The GHO Risk Council also lifted Prime’s base rate, while Ethereum’s USDC conversion module remained nearly empty.

entry.title: ZachXBT Says He Fronted $349,700 to Infiltrate Alleged Laundering Ring

entry.summary: Nearly 1.44 million ETH is waiting to begin staking, down 31% from Sept. 1 but still facing a roughly 25-day delay.

entry.summary: Buying an ftPUT NFT transfers its remaining FT tokens and redemption rights, while spot FT purchases carry no such protection.

entry.summary: Proposal 612 would extend treasury delays from two days to ten, while a wallet linked to Humpy has cast 1.75 million COMP votes in support.

entry.summary: The reported reduction follows a $100 million Tether investment and an expansion of the custodian’s institutional settlement business.

entry.summary: The venue would restrict trading and liquidity provision to approved wallets on X Layer, with no current support for aggregators.

entry.summary: Proposed tickers BITH and ETHK would use futures and reset leverage daily, exposing longer-term holders to compounding losses.

entry.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission published an Advanced Notice of Proposed Rulemaking covering retail crypto trading on margin, leverage or financing, and a new exchange registration category built for it. Chairman Michael Selig called it a federal option rather than a mandate. The notice

entry.title: Treasury Drops Crypto Wallet Surveillance Rules
entry.summary: FinCEN withdrew the 2020 unhosted wallet reporting proposal and its 2023 finding that crypto mixing is a primary money laundering concern. The agency said it will keep monitoring mixers and may act again

entry.title: Tim Draper's Firm Leads Strategic Round In Bitcoin Wallet Xverse
entry.summary: Trust Machines and Draper Dragon joined the round. Terms were not disclosed, and Xverse has not said what it raised or at what valuation.

entry.title: OKX And NYSE Owner's Venture Files To Trade 63 Tokenized Stocks Onchain
entry.summary: OKXICE told the SEC it will run tokenized equity trading through permissioned Uniswap v4 pools on X Layer. Cerebras has already filed an objection to being included.

entry.title: Safe Investor Greenfield Files Swiss Regulatory Complaint Over Foundation Governance
entry.summary: Greenfield says it asked the Safe Ecosystem Foundation to remove Gnosis co-founder Stefan George from its board and add independent members, and that every request was rejected

entry.title: S&P Global Puts A Letter Grade On DeFi Lending Vaults
entry.summary: The Vault Risk Assessment scores a vault from AAA(v) to D(v), and the curator running it can cap the result. S&P has not assessed a vault yet.

entry.title: Plume Opens Tokenized Vault Backed By Fidelity's Bond ETF
entry.summary: The nBND vault holds shares of an actively managed ETF rather than short-dated Treasuries, pushing onchain fixed income into credit and duration.

entry.title: Hyperliquid’s USDC Yield Program Gets $14.6 Million for HYPE Buybacks
entry.summary: The first reserve-yield payment awaits transfer to the Assistance Fund, adding buyback funding tied to USDC balances rather than trading volume.

entry.title: Kalshi and Coinbase Win Partial Illinois Ruling on Sports Contracts
entry.summary: The judge found state licensing rules likely conflict with federal derivatives law, but left transaction fees unresolved and ordered the parties to propose injunction terms.

entry.title: Arbitrum Pauses New Stylus Activations in Emergency Security Action
entry.summary: Active contracts can still run and renew, while a new BoLD guard could delay unconfirmed withdrawals if contradictory proofs are accepted.

entry.title: ICBA Sues OCC Over Crypto Trust Charters
entry.summary: The complaint targets Protego’s conditional approval and seeks to stop the agency from granting charters under its disputed rule and guidance.

entry.title: Ethereum Foundation Introduces zkAPI for Private API Payments
entry.summary: OA Chat supports the prepaid tool, which separates billing from requests but does not conceal prompts from AI providers.

entry.title: IMF Approves $138 Million for El Salvador After Bitcoin Waiver
entry.summary: The fund still expects no further Bitcoin accumulation beyond documented donations and wants the state’s remaining Chivo exposure fully unwound.

entry.title: Illinois Agrees to Six-Month Crypto Tax Delay, Subject to Court Approval
entry.summary: The levy would charge customers on asset value rather than gains, with draft rules covering paid custody, transfers and stablecoin settlement.

entry.title: Ripple and CSD BR Partner to Mirror Brazil's BTG Fund Records on XRP Ledger
entry.summary: The companies describe a live-transaction phase, with CSD BR retaining the official records for registration, deposit and settlement.

entry.title: Centrifuge Confirms Three Tokenized Funds Are Live on Arc
entry.summary: JAAA, JTRSY and HYB span US Treasuries and credit, with direct fund access limited to non-US professional investors.

entry.summary: Phase 1 would create a Cayman Islands entity and appoint independent officers; trademark, domain and codebase transfers would require later governance votes.

entry.title: Circle Urges EU to Replace Stablecoin Bank-Deposit Mandates
entry.summary: The USDC issuer also wants to preserve cross-border co-issuance and create a recognition route for foreign stablecoins, while central banks demand stronger safeguards.

entry.title: NEAR Intents GM Says $3.8 Million in Hack Funds Returned in Full
entry.summary: The published Bitcoin recovery wallet received about 34.59 BTC. The protocol had already pledged to compensate the lost funds in full.

entry.title: Blast to Shut Down Layer 2, Citing Unsustainable Costs
entry.summary: About $63.5 million remains in Blast’s canonical bridge. Users have until Oct. 26 to withdraw through the normal interface, with contract-based withdrawals continuing afterward.

entry.title: Visa Says Business Programs Drive About 17% of Stablecoin Card Volume
entry.summary: Payment volume across Visa’s stablecoin-linked cards grew nearly 200% year over year in its fiscal second quarter.

entry.title: SMBC Nikko and Nethermind Plan Compliance Hooks for Uniswap Pools
entry.summary: An MOU with Uniswap Labs, Base and Nyx Foundation targets a Japan-focused DeFi gateway for completion by mid-2027.

entry.summary: Points holders have 10 days to buy from a 50 million-token allocation at $0.26 per KNTQ, potentially generating $13 million in gross proceeds.

entry.title: Fiserv Launches Roughrider Coin Settlement on Solana
entry.summary: VersaBank issues the bank-only token, which Fiserv says serves a North Dakota network of more than 90 banks and credit unions.

entry.title: Shevchenko Gives NEAR Intents Attacker 48 Hours
entry.summary: The general manager of NEAR Intents said the attacker who drained a preliminary $3.8 million has been identified, and posted three addresses for the money's return. None had received the funds as of early Oct. 2.

entry.title: SEC Proposes Crypto Self-Custody Route for Investment Advisers
entry.summary: The proposal also sets conditions for state trust company custody, with public comments due 60 days after Federal Register publication.

entry.title: US Sanctions A7 Network, Proposes Ban on Sub-Agent Payments
entry.summary: FinCEN says A7’s sub-agents processed more than $17 billion in dollar-denominated transactions from January 2025 through June 2026.

entry.title: Stablecoin Treasury Growth Partly Offsets China’s Retreat, SF Fed Study Finds
entry.summary: Issuers favor short-term debt, while China’s decline is mostly in longer-dated securities. The authors say additional demand depends on who buys stablecoins.

entry.title: OpenZeppelin and T-REX Network Introduce new Framework for Regulated Token Eligibility and Recovery
entry.summary: The redesign requires new deployments rather than in-place upgrades of existing 2.x identities, according to the project's changelog.

entry.title: Onchain Perps Close Execution Gap With CEXs, Castle Labs Says
entry.summary: Hyperliquid held as much resting liquidity as the median of Binance, Bybit and OKX on four of five crypto assets and cost less to trade, a Castle Labs study of live order books found. The gap that remains sits in how venues price stocks and commodities when the underlying market is closed.

entry.summary: Redeeming burns the tokens and ends their claim on future deposits. Holders can instead wait for revenue-funded recovery or sell their DFX.

entry.summary: Holders must open a 180-day lock and cast governance votes to claim rewards, with no fixed payout rate.

entry.title: Blockworks Opens Its Full Dataset To AI Agents
entry.summary: A hosted Model Context Protocol server gives ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor read access to the datasets behind Blockworks research and its Intel app. It comes with every API plan at no extra cost, on the same key and the same permissions.

entry.summary: Bitget and Liquid Network dominate the month's losses, while recovered and frozen funds substantially reduce the remaining damage.

entry.summary: The RLUSD and PYUSD vaults had about $8.46 million and $2.38 million of available liquidity, respectively, in Morpho’s latest snapshots.

entry.summary: MetaMask says its investigation has found no indication that wallets or customer funds were affected. Lido estimates the exit, withdrawal and re-entry cycle could take up to about 45 days.

entry.summary: The ADAPT Act would exempt qualifying stablecoin purchases and crypto-paid transaction costs of $10 or less from gain-or-loss recognition, while restricting loss harvesting.

entry.summary: Existing firms that apply by Feb. 28, 2027 can keep taking new business if their applications are still pending when the regime starts on Oct. 25.

entry.title: Base Ships Cobalt With Conditional Transactions And A Seize Function
entry.summary: The year's third Base upgrade lets traders submit transactions that stay dormant until price or block conditions are met, and adds three changes to the B20 token standard behind Coinbase's tokenized stocks. Base's documentation for the new transaction method lists it as running on test networks.

entry.summary: Borrow Kit lets apps offer cirBTC-backed loans, while Onramp purchases require provider identity checks and regional eligibility.

entry.summary: Mastercard's route runs through BVNK, while Visa offers limited beta access and Coinbase is scheduled to follow on Oct. 1.

entry.summary: The seven-day test sent funds from Jersey to the US in under an hour, including over the weekend, with Lloyds using Canton and Visa a separate blockchain.

entry.title: Aave V4 TVL Climbs 82% in September as Arc Reaches $181 Million
entry.summary: Active loans in DefiLlama’s tracked markets rose 76%, while V4 generated just 2% of Aave’s trailing 30-day protocol revenue.

entry.title: ESMA Proposes MiCA Rules for DeFi Gateways, Staking and Lending
entry.summary: The regulator also wants to bar crypto firms from all MiCA-licensable services involving noncompliant stablecoins, extending restrictions to custody and transfers.

entry.title: Most Tokenized Cash Never Trades, Dune Finds
entry.summary: Tokenized real-world assets reached $34.5 billion at the end of August, according to a Dune report published Wednesday. Tokenized Treasury funds make up half of it and turned over 0.006% of supply that month. Equities, 8% of the market, generated 93% of spot volume.

entry.title: Ostium Recovery Plan Repays 3,321 Wallets In Full, Leaves 345 To Choose
entry.summary: Wallets that lost $1,000 or less get everything back when the portal opens Wednesday. The 345 wallets carrying at least 86% of the $23.8 million loss choose between a $1,000 payment and a pro-rata claim on funds Ostium has not yet recovered.

entry.title: Gate: Same-Name Error Triggers Liquidations in Perp Market
entry.summary: Two self-identified Gate managers said a same-name asset error affected 200 accounts and that balance displays were being restored.

entry.title: Stable Announces Visa Direct Integration for Bank and Mobile Wallet Payouts
entry.summary: Visa previously announced stablecoin funding and payout pilots; Stable has not specified when its connection will be available or which markets it will cover.

entry.title: HSBC Names Hong Kong Stablecoin 'RedCoin' Ahead of Retail Rollout
entry.summary: The Hong Kong dollar token is planned for the second half of 2026, with initial distribution limited to PayMe and the HSBC HK Mobile App.

entry.title: Kalshi Files to End Volume Incentive Program
entry.summary: The reward pools exclude members with market-maker agreements; Kalshi cited separate liquidity payments to explain clustered ether perpetual trades.

entry.summary: Trade approvals will default to on, while a planned Loops feature will let users run recurring strategies around the clock.

entry.summary: Sequoia and Wellington are in talks to lead the financing, which would lift Kalshi's valuation about 82% above its confirmed May round.

entry.summary: The eight-contract lineup offers no-expiry trading through Robinhood Derivatives and Bitstamp, with broader access planned in the coming months.

entry.summary: The asset manager points to tiny, round-the-clock payments for data and computing power, while traditional checkout systems retain a role.

entry.summary: Two New York lawsuits allege investors were shown fictitious profits and pressed for more money when they tried to withdraw.

entry.summary: Uphold today releases research which reveals that 75% of American banks have blockchain finance programmes underway: 22% have projects that are live or scaling, while an additional 53% are piloting or assessing specific use cases.

entry.title: House Oversight Expands Prediction-Market Probe to Hyperliquid
entry.summary: Comer is seeking identity-verification and suspicious-trading records from Hyperliquid Labs, Crypto.com and PredictIt owner Aristotle Exchange.

entry.summary: The Morpho-powered borrowing product runs on Base and is available to eligible US users outside New York.

entry.summary: The government-backed app uses self-custodial wallets. Its $2 cross-border processing fee is separate from funding and cash-withdrawal charges.

entry.summary: About $166,000 passed through the swap system, while Bitget says NEAR Intents waived its recovery-bounty share.

entry.title: Ethlabs Says CCIP 2.0 Cuts Ethereum Confirmation Wait to Seconds
entry.summary: Faster transfers require opt-in settings, while Ethereum’s full-finality guarantees and CCIP’s default wait remain unchanged.

entry.title: Coinbase Wins CFTC Approval for In-House Derivatives Clearing
entry.summary: The new clearinghouse can handle fully collateralized contracts; Coinbase will keep outside partners for margined futures and planned single-stock perpetuals.

entry.title: Coinbase Teases Pokémon Card Packs Backed by Physical Collectibles
entry.summary: Collectors would be able to keep their pulls in a vault or have them shipped. Coinbase has not set a launch date in its teaser.

entry.summary: Existing integrations keep working with full-finality defaults, while new token-pool controls require an opt-in contract upgrade.

entry.title: Dune Flags Yield Shortfall at Tokenized Money Funds

entry.title: Citi Taps Coinbase for Corporate Stablecoin Payments: WSJ
entry.summary: The firms’ October 2025 collaboration initially focused on fiat funding and withdrawals for Coinbase’s on- and off-ramps.

entry.title: Bitget Reopens Bitcoin Withdrawals After $387.5 Million Breach
entry.summary: ETH and USDT withdrawals remain paused, while CEO Gracy Chen pledges to replenish the protection fund above $300 million this week.

entry.title: Bitcoin ETFs Draw Nearly $3 Billion in Seven Sessions as 2026 Flows Turn Positive
entry.summary: US spot funds finished Sept. 25 with about $1.02 billion in net inflows for the year, reversing a $1.96 billion deficit before the streak.
